Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: Chose an invalid class composition by assuming “bear” meant a Druid and “Metamorphosis” meant a Demon Hunter, which introduces leather wearers and violates multiple constraints: it breaks the “two plate, two cloth” requirement, makes the dropped Kilt usable (contradicting “no one can use it”), and even relied on two Mages in the role breakdown (violating unique classes). This misinterpretation led directly to the wrong final answer.
